subject: Strategic retention stipend + equity rationalization for senior infra engineer
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Strategic retention stipend + equity rationalization for senior infra engineer

Hi Laura / Vivek,

Quick background: Samir Patel (Infra, IC4) has notified us he has an external offer and wants to accelerate. He is critical to the Ops migration (scheduled Q1->Q2 handoff) and to a cross-team on-call consolidation effort. Losing him will materially increase delivery risk and force hiring + contractor spend.

Request: approval for a one-time retention stipend and an equity consolidation (re-grant + top-up) outside of the regular cycle. Proposed package is in the attached model but summary: 
- One-time cash stipend: $25,000 (paid over two installments)
- Equity: consolidation of legacy grants + a 0.35% top-up (4-year vest, 1yr cliff on the top-up)
- Term: 6 months retention expectation tied to project milestones

Why this is an exception: comp band at hire was low due to market timing; Samir's current contribution and replacement risk justify an exception over a standard merit. Candidate replacement timeline: 3–5 months; contractor estimate: ~$60k/month to cover ramp.

Attachments: samir_retention_model.xlsx (workbook with cost vs. replacement), draft approval memo outline.

Can you review and advise whether we can move forward with a leadership exception today? If we get a green light, I will loop in Total Rewards and legal for paperwork.

Thanks,
Priyom
---
Priyom Das
Engineering Manager, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 12:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Strategic retention stipend + equity rationalization for senior infra engineer

Thanks Priyom — reviewed the spreadsheet quickly. A few immediate asks before I can sign off: 

1) Break out baseline comp, current equity schedule (all grant ids), and the proposed consolidated grant terms in a single tab (for audit).
2) Include candidate-side counterfactual: 3 replacement scenarios (internal shift, external hire, contractor) with cost and timeline.
3) Confirm manager calibration: where would this sit relative to band medians; this feels like a band exception not just a top-up.
4) Risk points: list three measurable milestones that trigger the second installment / vesting acceleration (dates or deliverables).

Monica — please review for headcount and run the comp modeling sanity check. If Total Rewards agrees we can present this as a limited leadership exception and route to Vivek for final OK.

I attached a quick template I use for exception memos (comp_approval_memo.pdf). Once Priyom updates the model, I'll draft the formal memo.

Laura
---
Laura Bennett
VP, People Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 10:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Strategic retention stipend + equity rationalization for senior infra engineer

Laura — thanks, incorporated edits and added the requested tabs (see attached: samir_retention_model.xlsx). Short summary of updates: 

- Tab A: baseline_comp — shows current base (142,000), current equity schedule (grant IDs: GR-2019-341, GR-2021-019), and total realized value estimate.
- Tab B: options_compare — internal shift vs external hire vs contractor (includes ramp weeks and contractor blended rate).
- Tab C: milestones — three triggers: 1) DB migration cutover (2027-02-15), 2) on-call consolidation completed (2027-03-01), 3) knowledge-transfer sign-off to SRE lead (by 2027-04-01). Second stipend installment and top-up cliff depend on milestone 1 and 2 being on track.
- Band placement: proposed top-up places Samir at ~88th percentile of IC4 same-role comp in our benchmark set (US West). Rationale in Tab D.

Also ran a quick ROI: cost of package (cash + equity topline over 4 years, discounted) vs median contractor replacement + ramp — still favorable in 9-month horizon.

If this passes your check, next steps I propose: 
1) Laura: sign the exception memo and mark up any legal caveats.
2) Monica: confirm that headcount and budget owner sign-off is recorded and update finance ledger.
3) Vivek: final leadership approval for exception.

CC'ing Jamie Ortiz (external comp consultant) for optional blind review — Jamie, if you can spot-check the benchmarks on Tab D that would be great.

— Priyom
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Jamie Ortiz <jamie.ortiz@pivotal-partners.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Strategic retention stipend + equity rationalization for senior infra engineer

Thanks team — reviewed Priyom's update and Laura's memo. I approve this as a one-time leadership exception under the following conditions: 

- Cash stipend capped at $25k, paid in two installments (50% now, 50% upon milestone 2).
- Equity top-up capped at 0.35% with standard 4-year vest and 1-year cliff on the top-up portion; consolidation of legacy grants only for calculation simplicity, not forgiveness of prior grants.
- Legal to prepare a retention addendum tied to the milestones above; Total Rewards to confirm any tax/withholding notes and run through payroll timing.
- This approval is limited to Samir specifically and is not precedence-setting; any deviation needs exec review.

Monica — please prepare the comp doc for signature and route to Legal / Payroll. Laura — please finalize the approval memo and add the exec sign-off block.

Vivek
---
Vivek Kulkarni
Chief Product Officer (acting)
Redwood Inference
